$description: Security headers the site is served with (make web-data writes apps/web dist/_headers for Cloudflare Pages from this file). Read on 2026-11-01 from Cloudflare Pages' headers documentation (rule format, 100 rules, 2,000 characters a line), MDN's header references (Permissions-Policy, CSP, COOP, CORP, Referrer-Policy) and hstspreload.org (preload needs max-age of one year or more, includeSubDomains and preload). The Content Security Policy is as strict as the built site allows: every script, style, font, image, film and request comes from this site, there is no inline script or style (make web-lint checks this), no eval, and nothing may frame the site. JSON-LD and the scene input blocks are data, not scripts, so script-src does not govern them. A browser test (apps/web/e2e/security.spec.ts) loads real pages under exactly this policy and fails on any violation.

hsts.$description: Off until launch (docs/setup/cloudflare.md step 7): HSTS is hard to undo. At launch ramp up as hstspreload.org advises: 300 seconds, a week (604800), a month (2592000), then two years (63072000) with preload, checking the site between stages. Preload needs maxAge of at least 31536000, includeSubDomains and preload.

securityTxt.$description: /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116, read 2026-11-01): Contact and Expires are required; Expires is an RFC 3339 date and time, recommended less than a year ahead, so the build fails once it has passed or if it is more than a year away. The contact is a confirmed fact, so it is never typed twice. Renew Expires and the date at least once a year.
